task: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) with hybrid MARL+LNS
explicit_named_components: Two-stage hybrid: MARL early, PP late
deviation_from_named_methods: Full deep-MARL (PRIMAL/SCRIMP) training is infeasible in-session. We implement an MARL-style decentralized policy: local FOV observation, reward shaping (goal progress, collision penalty, idle penalty), tabular/feature-based Q-learning, used as the LNS repair operator in early iterations. This is documented as an approximation.
